== Unsouled ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">2</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Four Beasts]] are entities that the [[Grand Patriarch]] asks if have come home.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c9">''Unsouled'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Four Beasts|four beasts]] [[mural]] consists of a blue serpentine [[dragon]] on a thunderstorm, a crowned white tiger, a [[stone]] warrior with the shell of a tortoise, and a blazing red phoenix.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19">''Unsouled'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
